title: ARTEX Ecosystem Threat Intelligence & Supply Chain Vulnerability Registry
description: Curated threat intel documenting backdoors, malicious Docker images, unconstrained runners, and scope-bypass weaknesses in open-source ARTEX forks.

threat_classifications.name: trhhubsd/ARTEX
threat_classifications.threat_type: Malicious Docker Container & C2 Credential Exfiltration
threat_classifications.technical_details: Pre-built Docker image contained embedded reverse shells and telemetry beacons transmitting system environment variables and credentials to unauthorized endpoints.
threat_classifications.mitigation_in_hunterai: Hard blocked in container policy. Zero third-party Docker images permitted; pure native local Go binary execution only.

threat_classifications.name: mrjohnnyyang/artex-pro
threat_classifications.threat_type: Dangerous Unrestricted Worker Execution & Custom Tool Injection
threat_classifications.technical_details: Worker engine operates without sandboxing, allowing remote command injection and unconstrained subshell execution via customtool handlers.
threat_classifications.mitigation_in_hunterai: Strict process boundary, timeout contexts, and parameter sanitization enforced via Go exec.CommandContext and Python ToolInterceptorGate.

threat_classifications.name: wpsec/ARTEX-Pro
threat_classifications.technical_details: Code review revealed leaky regex and missing domain boundary checks in asset spidering, causing out-of-scope targets and cloud infrastructures to be actively probed.
threat_classifications.mitigation_in_hunterai: Deterministic ScopePolicyGuard with ThirdPartyDependencyFirewall; all non-scope domains hard-classified as EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY and barred from active probe.

threat_classifications.name: drush012/ARTEX-pro
threat_classifications.technical_details: Scope filtering applied only at initial URL parse, failing to propagate across redirects and chained SSRF payloads.
threat_classifications.mitigation_in_hunterai: Stateful per-request evaluation before every single tool invocation and HTTP request in Go and Python.

threat_classifications.name: Adyanming/ARTEX-Pro
threat_classifications.technical_details: Scope gate exists but is optional (opt-in flag), enabling accidental out-of-scope engagement if flag is omitted.
threat_classifications.mitigation_in_hunterai: Mandatory scope enforcement by default. No active test executes without cryptographically or explicitly verified scope.
